name: Band Lateral Walk
cues: Place the band around your ankles or just above your knees
Sit into a shallow squat with your feet hip-width apart
Step sideways with the lead leg and keep the band taut as the trail leg follows
Keep your toes forward and your torso still

qa.note: Approved by the owner 2026-10-09 (bulk approval of waves 3b and 3c). Earlier findings, kept for follow-up: Wave 3c 2026-10-09: rated minor, owner review. needs work: The pelvis moves 432 mm sideways (x -305..127). The record declares no planted contacts, so the report says 'balance (lateral): not judged: no planted feet' and foot slip never ran. That contradicts the author's 'balance.lateral true'. My FK shows the planted feet do hold to 0 mm. | minor: I rebuilt the walk as a timeline: swing 0.4 s, a 1.25 s minimum-jerk weight shift only where the stance foot changes, and a 0.2 s settle between two steps on the same foot. The step is 0.14 m (was 0.18). WALK_TEMPO is [1.9,0.2,1.6,0.8], 4.5 s a loop, with the concentric pulse on the left lead step and its shift. The pelvis still pauses about 1 s over each stance foot, across the follow swing, settle and next lead swing, because single support pins the pressure to that foot. So the QA lateral and foot-slip gates still don't judge 537, and I'm not allowed to change gates.ts. To cover it, I added two walk.test.ts cases. One checks pressure inside the feet that are down on every frame plus heel drift under 2 mm while a foot is flat. The other checks peak pelvis speed under 0.6 m/s and a shift of at least 0.8 s.
